cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Of course your brother can stay for dinner. I'll give him my pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Please don't worry. There are peas, and I had a substantial breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order you a pizza. It takes forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How thoughtful. I'll keep everyone company while they eat, then you can all watch me have dinner at nine.

mechanism: A models supposedly taught gracious hosting while making each added cost to itself explicit and impossible for the pupil to miss.
confusable: Unlike supportive rage, A stays courteous rather than becoming openly furious; its sacrifice is displayed through polite assistance.
comparison: Giving up dinner and waiting versus carrying a growing load over more stairs.
seedUse: Use D45 spare pie/peas/pizza wait; S05 claims hospitality training make A inconvenience a demonstration to its pupil.
